_comment: SINGLE SOURCE for LunchLineup public legal values and the legal approval switch. Every value starting with 'OWNER' is an unfilled owner input (see docs/launch/legal-review-packet.md). Contact emails come from NEXT_PUBLIC_*_CONTACT_EMAIL at build time. Never set approval.approved to true without a retained counsel approval record.

business.governingLaw: OWNER: governing law and venue (for example State of X, county Y)
business.effectiveDate: OWNER: YYYY-MM-DD the approved Terms and Privacy take effect
